intro.title: text-overflow and white-space
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple webpage that demonstrates how to control text that overflows its container. You will learn the core CSS concepts of text-overflow and white-space to manage text wrapping and truncation. The main technologies involved are CSS properties like white-space: nowrap, overflow: hidden, and text-overflow: ellipsis. By the end, you'll be able to create clean, user-friendly text displays that handle long content gracefully.
intro.usecase: The text-overflow and white-space properties are essential for creating clean, readable interfaces where space is limited. In data-rich dashboards, they prevent long text entries in table cells or card titles from breaking layouts. E-commerce sites use them to truncate product names in search results and navigation menus while maintaining consistent alignment. Form designers apply these properties to keep input field labels and error messages contained within their designated areas.
